changes.new: Medium-wide shot in a generic 1970s airport concourse. One anonymous adult traveler strains forward with a heavy plain suitcase in each hand, shoulders lowered and face clearly tense. The two hand-carried cases and the effort in the traveler's face are the focal subjects. A plain open wall on the left leaves space for an added headline.
